description: Lint DPO/ORPO preference datasets (JSONL/JSON) by reproducing the trainer's tokenization and truncation. Finds rows TRL silently drops, pairs that become identical after truncation, contradictory labels and length bias, before you spend GPU time.
help.tokenizer: Hugging Face tokenizer id or local folder (needs prefcheck[hf]); without it the approximate practice mode is used
help.offline: read the tokenizer from local files only, fail fast instead of retrying the network (same as HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1)
help.max_length: TRL max_length to simulate: a positive integer or 'none' (default: 1024)
help.config: prefcheck.toml with rule severities and thresholds
help.json: write the machine-readable report to PATH
help.markdown: write a Markdown report to PATH
help.bad_rows: write rows with errors to PATH (original row plus a _prefcheck field)
help.clean: write the rows without errors to PATH (original text, original order)
help.fail_on: exit with 1 when findings of this level exist: error, warn or never (default: error)
help.max_findings: show at most N findings in the terminal table (default: 50)
help.lang: screen language: en or ko (default: PREFCHECK_LANG, then LC_ALL/LC_MESSAGES/LANG, else en)
help.list_rules: list all rules with their default severity and exit
help.help: show this help message and exit
error.no_data: {prog}: error: a DATA file is required, for example: {prog} data.jsonl --max-length 1024 (see --help)
error.file_not_found: File not found: {path}. Check the path.
error.not_utf8: Cannot read {path}: it is not valid UTF-8 ({reason} at byte {pos}). Save the file as UTF-8 (JSONL) and retry.
error.output_is_input: Output path {path} is the same as the input file and would overwrite it. Choose a different output path.
error.json_line: Invalid JSON at {path} line {line}: {msg} (column {col}). Fix or remove that line.
error.json_file: Invalid JSON in {path} (line {line}, column {col}): {msg}. Fix the syntax or use JSONL.
error.format_undetected: Could not detect a preference format: no row has both 'chosen' and 'rejected'. Expected TRL-style rows with prompt, chosen and rejected fields.
error.hf_missing: Real tokenizer mode needs the optional dependencies. Install them with: pip install "prefcheck[hf]"
error.tokenizer_load: Could not load tokenizer '{name}' ({reason}). Check the model id and your network, or pass a local folder.
error.tokenizer_load_offline: Could not load tokenizer '{name}' offline ({reason}). Pass a local folder or populate the cache first (or drop --offline).
error.config_missing: Config file not found: {path}. Check the path.
error.unknown_rule: Unknown rule id '{rule}'. Run `prefcheck --list-rules` to see the valid ids.
error.max_length: Invalid max_length '{value}': use a positive integer or 'none'.
banner.approx: NOTE: approximate mode (no tokenizer) - practice/mock mode. Token counts differ from your model; pass --tokenizer for real numbers.
summary.title: prefcheck {version} - preference data check
summary.settings: settings: max_length={max_length}, truncation={truncation}, tokenizer={tokenizer}, TRL rules {trl_rules}
metrics.title: Metrics
rules.title: Findings by rule
findings.title: Findings ({shown} of {total} shown)
findings.truncated: ... {shown} of {total} findings shown (raise --max-findings or use --json for all).
md.title: prefcheck report
rule.schema_error.desc: The row is unusable: missing field, wrong type, empty text or invalid roles.
rule.identical_pair.desc: chosen and rejected are identical, so the pair carries no preference.
rule.dropped_by_trl.desc: With keep_start the prompt alone fills max_length, so TRL silently drops the row.
rule.empty_completion_after_truncation.d: No response tokens are left after truncation, so the row gives no loss signal.
rule.identical_after_truncation.desc: chosen and rejected differ but become identical after truncation (loss 0.693, zero gradient).
rule.contradictory_label.desc: The same prompt appears with chosen and rejected swapped in another row.
rule.prompt_not_prefix.desc: The tokenized prompt is not a prefix of prompt+response, so the end of the prompt is missing from training.
rule.near_identical_pair.desc: chosen and rejected are equal after normalization or nearly equal (character 3-gram Jaccard).
rule.extreme_length_ratio.desc: The response length ratio is extreme, which can teach length instead of quality.
rule.duplicate_row.desc: The same prompt, chosen and rejected already appeared in an earlier row.
rule.implicit_prompt_split.desc: The implicit prompt cannot be split cleanly from chosen and rejected.
rule.mixed_format.desc: Rows mix formats; TRL decides prompt extraction and EOS handling from the first row only.
rule.length_bias.desc: Chosen responses are systematically longer than rejected ones (reference metric).
msg.dropped_by_trl: TRL drops this row: the prompt has {prompt_tokens} tokens and max_length is {max_length}.
msg.empty_completion_after_truncation: No response tokens remain after truncation (chosen {chosen_tokens}, rejected {rejected_tokens}).
msg.identical_after_truncation: chosen and rejected are identical after truncation to {kept_tokens} tokens (max_length {max_length}, {truncation}); the gradient is zero.
msg.contradictory_label: Same prompt as row {other_row} with chosen and rejected swapped.
msg.prompt_not_prefix: The end of the prompt ({dropped_tokens} tokens: {dropped_text}) is left out of the training sequence.
msg.near_identical_pair: chosen and rejected are nearly identical (similarity {similarity}).
msg.extreme_length_ratio: Response length ratio chosen/rejected is {ratio} ({chosen_tokens} vs {rejected_tokens} tokens).
msg.mixed_format: {rows} row(s) differ from the first row's format ({first}); formats seen: {kinds_text}. TRL decides prompt extraction and EOS handling from the first row only.
msg.length_bias: chosen is longer in {chosen_longer_ratio} of pairs and length correlates with the label (r = {point_biserial_r}); thresholds {ratio_threshold} / {r_threshold}.
schema.not_an_object: the row is not a JSON object.
schema.empty_messages: field '{field}' is an empty message list.
schema.mixed_types: field '{field}' mixes strings and message lists with the other fields.
schema.prompt_ends_with_assistant: the prompt ends with an assistant message.
schema.completion_not_assistant: the first message of '{field}' has role '{role}', expected 'assistant'.
split.no_divergence: chosen and rejected never diverge (one is a prefix of the other), so TRL keeps only the last element as the completion.
split.prompt_ends_with_assistant: the extracted prompt ends with an assistant message.
